name: ClickSyncr for Brevo
author: ClickSyncr

sections.description:
ClickSyncr for Brevo connects your Contact Form 7 forms to Brevo (formerly Sendinblue), so every form submission becomes a contact in your Brevo list — automatically, with no code.

Stop copying and pasting emails between your website and your email marketing. Map your form fields to Brevo once, and ClickSyncr keeps your audience growing on autopilot every time someone fills out a form.

“Brevo” and “Sendinblue” are trademarks of Sendinblue SAS. This plugin is an independent integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Sendinblue SAS or Brevo.

Why you’ll love it

  • Set up in minutes — paste your Brevo API key and you’re connected. No developers, no code.
  • Your lists load automatically — choose which Brevo list new contacts join, right inside the form editor.
  • Map any field — send names, phone numbers, and any custom Brevo attribute straight from your form.
  • No duplicate contacts — existing subscribers are updated and new ones are added, every single time.
  • A setup for every form — each Contact Form 7 form can sync to a different list with its own field mapping.
  • Lightweight and fast — built to WordPress standards, so it never slows your site down.
  • You stay in control — you decide exactly what data is sent, and to which list.

Learn more about the Contact Form 7 to Brevo integration.

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Edit any Contact Form 7 form and open the ClickSyncr Brevo tab.
  3. Paste your Brevo API key — your lists and contact fields load instantly.
  4. Choose a list and map your form fields to Brevo attributes (email is required).
  5. Save the form. Every submission now syncs to Brevo automatically.

What you’ll need

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • Contact Form 7 installed and activated
  • A Brevo account with an API key

Getting your Brevo API key

  1. Log in to your Brevo account.
  2. Go to Settings > SMTP & API > API Keys.
  3. Generate a new v3 API key.
  4. Paste it into the ClickSyncr Brevo tab.

Support

Need a hand? Visit clicksyncr.com and we’ll be glad to help.

External service: Brevo

This plugin connects to Brevo, the email marketing service, to sync your Contact Form 7 submissions with your Brevo account.

When data is sent: when you connect your API key, when your lists and fields load in the form editor, and when a visitor submits a form you’ve configured with ClickSyncr — at which point their form data (email and any mapped fields) is sent to Brevo.

What is sent: your Brevo API key (to authenticate), the subscriber’s email address and any contact fields you choose to map, and the list you select.

By using this plugin you agree to Brevo’s Privacy Policy. You are responsible for complying with applicable data-protection laws (such as GDPR) and for obtaining consent from your visitors before their data is collected and sent to Brevo.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “ClickSyncr for Brevo”.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.

After installation

  1. Make sure Contact Form 7 is installed and activated.
  2. Edit any Contact Form 7 form and open the ClickSyncr Brevo tab.
  3. Follow the on-screen setup. Full guidance is on the ClickSyncr for Brevo page.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Brevo account?

Yes. You’ll need an active Brevo account and an API key to sync your contacts.

Is Contact Form 7 required?

Yes. ClickSyncr connects Contact Form 7 to Brevo, so Contact Form 7 must be installed and activated.

Where do I find my Brevo API key?

Log in to Brevo, go to Settings > SMTP & API > API Keys, and generate a new v3 API key.

Can I map custom fields?

Absolutely. Map any Contact Form 7 field to any Brevo attribute, including the custom attributes in your Brevo account.

Will it create duplicate contacts?

No. If a contact already exists in your list, ClickSyncr updates it. If not, it adds a new one.

Can I use different settings for different forms?

Yes. Every Contact Form 7 form has its own ClickSyncr Brevo setup, so each can sync to a different list.
